description: This file defines the WebProcessor class used for processing log records, adding session and request info, and handling object context processing within the Goteo application, specifically related to Monolog integration.

classes.name: WebProcessor
classes.description: A class for processing log records, enriching them with session, request, and contextual data, used within the Goteo application's Monolog setup.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes WebProcessor with an HTTP request object.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Enables the object to be used as a callable for processing a log record.

methods.name: processRecord
methods.description: Enriches a log record with session, user, IP, method, language, currency, and shadowing info.

methods.name: processObject
methods.description: Processes a context array, converting objects into standardized associative arrays with their properties.
